'''Clue scroll (easy)''' is a [[cryptic clue]] obtained from [[Clue scroll (easy)|easy]] [[Treasure Trails]].

==Clue info==
{{Clue info
|id = 655
|text = The cryptic reveals who to speak to:<br><br>I wonder how many bronze shortswords he has handed out.
|notes = Speak to [[Vannaka]] in [[Edgeville Dungeon]].
|map = {{Map|3146,9913|mtype=pin|plane=0|mapID=-1}}
}}

==Transportation==
*[[Giantsoul amulet]] teleport to [[Bryophyta]] and use the [[Agility shortcut]] with 51 [[Agility]], otherwise [[giantsoul amulet]] teleport to [[Obor]].
*[[Paddewwa Teleport]].
*[[Amulet of glory]] teleport to [[Edgeville]] and enter [[Edgeville Dungeon]].
*[[Ring of returning]] or [[Respawn Teleport]] with [[respawn point]] set to [[Edgeville]].
*[[Combat bracelet]] teleport to [[Edgeville Monastery]].
*[[Fairy ring]] code {{fairycode|dkr}}.
*[[Varrock Teleport]] to the [[Grand Exchange]], [[skull sceptre (i)]] teleport, or [[chronicle]] teleport, and enter [[Edgeville Dungeon]] south of the [[Grand Exchange]] using a [[brass key]].
